User request, 2026-10-20. Provide New, Later and Acknowledged as three simultaneously available drag/drop destinations for per-user attention. Acknowledged is for items the user has seen and does not want to revisit later. Use the same shared splitter/pane composition as Waiting, In progress, Queued and Backlog in the Active column. Collapse and resize through the splitter system rather than nested details disclosures. Retain independent scrolling and a usable empty drop slot in each group. Apply to the board sections using attention grouping and preserve the agreed per-user timestamp and own-edit semantics; do not invent another persisted attention state. Capture exact grouping, drag/drop and splitter behavior and inspect the rendered result. Coordinate after the immediate app-performance repair.

Verification progress — 2026-10-20
Implemented New, Later and Acknowledged as independently scrolling shared splitter panes. Later and Acknowledged accept drag/drop; empty panes retain a card-sized area, and collapsed/empty groups avoid unnecessary fetching. New remains derived from per-user acknowledgement and latest update semantics. Exact grouping, Later-to-Acknowledged drag/drop, hidden layout and paging checks pass; screenshots inspected.

Completed verification — 2026-10-20
Commits: a3e1da7, a912ade, bfaeb66. Their messages contain the canonical task URLs. Build passed; final type gate checked 1,066 authored files with zero violations. Focused exact recordings, storage/stale-save checks and rendered screenshots pass. The full browser run recorded 267 passes and four failures; all four cases pass after focused recorder updates/rechecks. The full checkpoint still has four previously tracked Windows cancellation timing failures under load (task 916da876-ea04-42b3-ac05-93bba5129a8f remains Queued); no timing thresholds were weakened. The app has been restarted with the committed changes. See attached Performance pass verification 2026-10-20.json for measurements, coverage and limitations.
properties.title: Use splitter panes for New, Later and Acknowledged attention groups
